digest.component_or_area: bug-trend prevention program: observability, gates, migrations, and skill discipline
propositions: Bug provenance (detected-by metadata) must be observable at creation and queryable via bug_trends metrics without requiring new user input.
Deterministic pre-LLM gates must enforce: bypassed git writes, unread config fields, missing wall-clock bounds, unchecked acceptance criteria, and code comments referencing dead identifiers.
Reconciler transport must have end-to-end typing, field asymmetries pinned by property tests, and deduplicated pagination iterators.
Production shell logic (reconcile-bridge/canary, probe harness, vote normalizer) must be migrated to Python following strangler-fig policy.
Canary/automation bug filing must follow hardened dedup pattern and documented bug-creation contract; plan-review on oversized fixes must be enforced by Gerrit backstop.
Code comments citing dead SHAs, run-ids, or dates must be remediated to ticket citations with CI regression guard; skills (rebar-debug, rebar-implement, test-design) must encode discipline upgrades.
